title: Liquidity Structures

fixes.replaceWith: { yAxis: 85, label: "Range Low → Support (S/R Flip)", color: "#00d4d4" }
fixes.reason: Lesson bullet: 'S/R flip is the mechanism: range low becomes support (Under Over)'. The intro chart draws the full Under Over and pins the retest entry at idx15, but the 85 line is labelled only 'Range Low' — the flip-to-support mechanic (the named driver of the entry) is taught but not stated on the chart. Relabel (not a duplicate markPoint) makes it explicit.

edits.reason: Stop @80 ties to lesson bullet 'Stop for Under Over long: below the swing low of the fake breakdown with buffer to survive wicks' — fake-breakdown low is 81, so 80 sits just below it inside the [81,105] band (within wick margin). The intro chart already shows the long entry pin, so adding the invalidation completes the trade pedagogy. Rejected the auditor's second proposal of a duplicate S/R-flip markPoint at idx15 (the retest-entry pin already occupies idx15) in favour of the cleaner relabel fix.

fixes.replaceWith: { yAxis: 100, label: "Range High → Resistance (S/R Flip)", color: "#ff2e88" }
fixes.reason: Lesson bullet: 'S/R flip is the mechanism: range high becomes resistance (Over Under)'. This is the worked short trade; the 100 line is the retest/resistance level but labelled generically. Relabel makes the taught flip mechanic explicit.

edits.reason: Stop @108 ties to lesson bullet 'Stop for Over Under short: above the swing high of the fake breakout with buffer to survive wicks' — fake-breakout high is 107, so 108 sits just above it (band [87,107] + wick margin, ceiling ~111, so it does not clip). REJECTED the auditor's Target @88 proposal: the lesson text teaches no target for the Over Under short; the cited quote 'Target: Range High at $100' belongs to the BULLISH quiz explanation (range HIGH is the long's target), so applying it as a bearish short's range-low target is an unsupported inference — do not invent a level the text doesn't teach for this slot.

Both are routed to revealMarkPoints (post-answer) so the cutIndex:13 decision stays spoiler-free. Stop @idx10 ties to the explanation: 'the stop below the swing low of the fake breakdown has a clear and logical invalidation'; the fake-breakdown low is ~80, the lowest bar sits ~idx9-10, inside band [80,104]. Target @idx15 ties to explanation: 'Target: Range High at $100 or next key resistance'; price runs from 89 up to 104 over idx15-17 so it crosses the $100 target around idx15 — placing it at idx15 (rather than the auditor's idx17, which collides with the existing 'Higher High Confirmed' top pin) reduces label crowding while still landing where the target is reached.

notes: Chapter teaches two mirror structures (bullish Under Over / bearish Over Under) plus a completed Under Over quiz. Across all three slots the consistent GAP was the explicitly-taught Stop placement (below swing low for longs / above swing high for shorts) and the named S/R-flip mechanic, neither drawn. Accepted 4 of the auditor's items (intro stop, lesson stop, quiz stop reveal, quiz target reveal) and both relabel fixes (substituting a relabel for the auditor's redundant intro markPoint). REJECTED the lesson Target @88 as text-unsupported (its quote is the bullish quiz's range-HIGH target, not a bearish short target). Adjusted the quiz target reveal from idx17 to idx15 to avoid colliding with the existing 'Higher High Confirmed' pin. All yAxis values verified inside their bands incl. wick margin; all dataIndex values authored in the existing 0-based convention with no manual offset.
